name: Aurora Pro 15 Smartphone
shortDescription: Titanium frame, 6.7" ProMotion display and pro-grade triple camera.
description: The Aurora Pro 15 pairs a durable titanium frame with a 6.7-inch ProMotion display for buttery-smooth scrolling. Its triple-camera system captures stunning detail in any light, while the all-day battery keeps you moving.

name: Galaxy Nova X Smartphone
shortDescription: 120Hz AMOLED display with a 200MP main sensor and S-Pen support.
description: Galaxy Nova X brings a vivid 120Hz AMOLED display, a 200MP main camera and all-day battery life together in a sleek aluminum body, with full S-Pen support for note-taking on the go.

name: Pixel Breeze 9 Smartphone
shortDescription: Clean Android experience with computational photography that just works.
description: Pixel Breeze 9 focuses on what matters: a fast, clean software experience and a camera that makes every shot look professional, without breaking the bank.

name: Voltbook Air 14 Laptop
shortDescription: Fanless design, 18-hour battery and a stunning Liquid Retina display.
description: Voltbook Air 14 delivers pro-level performance in a silent, fanless design. With up to 18 hours of battery life and a brilliant Liquid Retina display, it's built for creators on the move.

name: ThinkForge X1 Laptop
shortDescription: Business-grade carbon fiber chassis with military-spec durability.
description: ThinkForge X1 is engineered for professionals: a carbon-fiber-reinforced chassis, blazing-fast NVMe storage and a keyboard rated among the best in the industry.

name: XPS Zenith 16 Laptop
shortDescription: InfinityEdge display and discrete graphics for demanding creative work.
description: XPS Zenith 16 combines an edge-to-edge InfinityEdge display with discrete graphics, making it a favorite among video editors and 3D artists alike.

name: ROG Blaze 17 Gaming Laptop
shortDescription: 240Hz display and desktop-class RTX graphics for competitive gaming.
description: ROG Blaze 17 is built for esports: a 240Hz QHD panel, desktop-class RTX graphics and an advanced cooling system that keeps frame rates high even during marathon sessions.

name: SoundWave Pro Wireless Earbuds
shortDescription: Industry-leading noise cancellation in a featherlight design.
description: SoundWave Pro earbuds deliver studio-quality sound with adaptive noise cancellation that adjusts to your surroundings, plus up to 30 hours of battery with the charging case.

name: BassPulse Portable Speaker
shortDescription: Waterproof speaker with 20-hour battery and punchy bass.
description: BassPulse is your poolside and campfire companion: fully waterproof, drop-resistant, and tuned for deep, punchy bass that fills any room or backyard.

name: AuraSound Studio Headphones
shortDescription: Reference-grade over-ear headphones for critical listening.
description: AuraSound Studio headphones are tuned by audio engineers for a flat, accurate response, wrapped in memory-foam ear cushions for hours of fatigue-free listening.

name: PulseFit Watch Series 7
shortDescription: Always-on display, blood oxygen sensing and 18-hour battery.
description: PulseFit Watch Series 7 keeps you connected and healthy with an always-on Retina display, advanced health sensors and seamless notifications right on your wrist.

name: TrailPace GPS Sports Watch
shortDescription: Multi-sport GPS watch with 2-week battery life.
description: TrailPace is built for endurance athletes, tracking dozens of sports profiles with pinpoint GPS accuracy and a battery that lasts up to two weeks per charge.

name: SkyView 4K Drone
shortDescription: 4K stabilized aerial footage with 34-minute flight time.
description: SkyView captures cinema-grade 4K footage from the sky with a 3-axis gimbal, obstacle sensing in all directions, and up to 34 minutes of flight time per battery.

name: MotionCam Gimbal Stabilizer
shortDescription: 3-axis smartphone gimbal for silky-smooth handheld video.
description: MotionCam pairs with your smartphone to deliver silky-smooth, professional-looking footage with intelligent tracking and gesture control.

name: HomeHub Smart Display
shortDescription: Voice-controlled smart display for your kitchen or living room.
description: HomeHub puts your calendar, recipes, and smart home controls on a beautiful 10-inch display, all controllable with your voice.

name: GuardCam Outdoor Security Camera
shortDescription: Weatherproof 2K camera with color night vision and AI alerts.
description: GuardCam watches over your home in stunning 2K clarity, day or night, and sends smart alerts the moment it detects a person, vehicle or package.

name: GlowStrip Ambient LED Kit
shortDescription: App-controlled RGB LED strip that syncs with music and movies.
description: GlowStrip transforms any room with millions of colors, music sync, and scene presets — all controlled from your phone or by voice.

name: NitroPad Mechanical Keyboard
shortDescription: Hot-swappable mechanical keyboard with per-key RGB.
description: NitroPad gives competitive gamers the edge with hot-swappable switches, per-key RGB lighting and a rock-solid aluminum frame.

name: PrecisionX Gaming Mouse
shortDescription: 26K DPI sensor with a featherweight 58g design.
description: PrecisionX is built for esports pros: a 26,000 DPI optical sensor, ultra-light 58g body, and 70-hour battery life on a single charge.

name: Nebula 27 Gaming Monitor
shortDescription: 27" QHD 165Hz panel with 1ms response time.
description: Nebula 27 delivers tear-free, blur-free gaming with a QHD 165Hz IPS panel, 1ms response time and factory color calibration for content creation too.

name: PowerCell 20K Power Bank
shortDescription: 20,000mAh power bank with 65W fast charging for laptops and phones.
description: PowerCell 20K charges your laptop and phone at the same time with 65W fast charging, packed into a pocketable, TSA-friendly design.

name: TriCharge 3-in-1 Wireless Charger
shortDescription: Charge your phone, watch and earbuds at once.
description: TriCharge keeps your nightstand tidy, wirelessly charging your phone, watch and earbuds simultaneously with MagSafe-compatible alignment.

name: ArmorShell Protective Case
shortDescription: Military-grade drop protection without the bulk.
description: ArmorShell survives drops up to 3 meters while staying slim enough to slip in and out of your pocket easily.

name: FlexArm Laptop Stand
shortDescription: Adjustable aluminum stand for ergonomic desk setups.
description: FlexArm elevates your laptop to eye level and improves airflow, with tool-free height and angle adjustment for the perfect ergonomic setup.

name: CrystalView 4K Webcam
shortDescription: 4K webcam with auto-framing for crisp video calls.
description: CrystalView keeps you sharp and centered in every call with 4K HDR video, auto light correction and AI-powered auto-framing.

name: OrbitBuds Sport Earbuds
shortDescription: Sweatproof true wireless earbuds built for workouts.
description: OrbitBuds stay locked in during your toughest workouts with an IP67 rating, secure ear hooks and punchy bass to keep you motivated.

name: StreamCast Portable Projector
shortDescription: 1080p smart projector with autofocus and built-in streaming apps.
description: StreamCast turns any wall into a home theater with native 1080p resolution, instant autofocus and all your favorite streaming apps built right in.

name: TabletPro 12 Slate
shortDescription: 12.4" AMOLED tablet with stylus support for work and creativity.
description: TabletPro 12 combines a vivid AMOLED display with stylus support and a detachable keyboard, making it just as capable for notes as it is for movies.

name: EchoDot Smart Speaker Mini
shortDescription: Compact smart speaker with voice assistant built in.
description: EchoDot Mini brings voice control, music streaming and smart home commands to any room, at a price that makes it easy to fill your whole house.
